title: No confusion in law: Supreme Court on concerns of SIR deletions leading to denial of benefits in West Bengal
description: The Supreme Court on Friday adjourned to August a petition related to the aftermath of Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls in West Bengal, stating that it had already clarified the law that Election Commission of India (ECI) cannot determine citizenship.A Bench of Chief Justice of India (CJI) Surya Kant, Justice Joymalya Bagchi and Justice V Mohana made the observation after Senior Advocate Gopal Sankaranarayanan submitted that after exclusion of voters from electoral rolls, they
